title: Which Band Member Are You?
description: Every legendary band needs five kinds of star. When your crew goes on tour, which one are you?

answers.text: Front and center, naturally
Doing something interesting off to the side
Behind the camera — you'd rather take the photo
Back row, perfectly content
Love it. The mic finds you.
Great, as long as you can show rather than tell
Fine, but you'd rather someone else did it
You wrote the speech. Someone else can give it.

questions.text: How do you handle public speaking?

answers.text: Pitching the destination with full enthusiasm
Keeping everyone on schedule, loudly
Going along happily with whatever's decided
The group chat poet documenting everything

questions.text: Your role when friends plan a trip:

answers.text: 'You light up every room'
'How did you DO that?'
'Nothing works without you'
'That thing you made? It meant something to me.'

questions.text: Pick a compliment that would make your week:

answers.text: Telling the story everyone's gathered around
Showing someone a trick in the corner, crowd forming
Starting the dancing, refusing to let it die
Having one great conversation all night

questions.text: At a party, you're the one:

answers.text: Practice obsessively, perform effortlessly
Steady output, powerful bursts
Quietly essential — things fall apart without you
Best ideas arrive at 2 AM
Openly and at full volume
Through energy — you can't hide a mood
Rarely, but when you do, it counts
In writing, always in writing

questions.text: Pick a superpower for daily life:

answers.text: Instant crowd charisma
Mastering any skill in a week
Boundless energy on demand
Hearing what people mean, not just what they say
Give the speech that gets everyone believing again
Head down, sharpen the craft, let the work talk
Keep the rhythm going until everyone finds it again
Hold steady — someone has to be the calm one

questions.text: The band hits a rough patch. You:

answers.text: The solo everyone air-guitars forever
The intro beat everyone recognizes in one second
The groove people can't help moving to
The line people tattoo on their arms

questions.text: Your dream contribution to a hit song:

results.description: The quiet foundation everything is built on. You don't chase the spotlight — you hold the whole thing together, and the people who matter know exactly how essential you are.
Pure engine. Your energy sets the pace for everyone around you, and when you're locked in, the whole room moves with you. Nothing works without the beat.
Craft plus showmanship. You practice in private so you can amaze in public, and your best moments make people ask 'how?!' — which is exactly the point.
Born for the front of the stage. Expressive, magnetic, and fearless with a spotlight, you give the group its voice and the crowd its reason to cheer.
The soul behind the sound. You notice everything, feel it deeply, and turn it into words that stick with people forever. The hits exist because you do.
